sql: SELECT insert_date, count(*) n, count(distinct city_name) cities,group_concat(city_name) names FROM cities WHERE country_code_2='cn' AND insert_date >= '2021-07-01' AND insert_date < '2021-08-01' GROUP BY insert_date ORDER BY insert_date

WITH d AS (SELECT distinct date(insert_date) dt FROM cities WHERE country_code_2='cn' AND insert_date >= '2021-07-01' AND insert_date < '2021-08-01'),g AS (SELECT dt,julianday(dt)-row_number() over(order by dt) island FROM d) SELECT min(dt) start,max(dt) end,count(*) days FROM g GROUP BY island ORDER BY start

WITH c AS (SELECT date(insert_date) dt,city_name,row_number() over(partition by date(insert_date) order by city_id,city_name) rn FROM cities WHERE country_code_2='cn' AND insert_date >= '2021-07-01' AND insert_date < '2021-08-01'), d AS (SELECT dt,city_name,julianday(dt)-row_number() over(order by dt) island FROM c WHERE rn=1), s AS (SELECT island,count(*) days FROM d GROUP BY island) SELECT d.dt AS date,upper(substr(city_name,1,1))||lower(substr(city_name,2)) AS city_name FROM d JOIN s USING(island) WHERE days=(SELECT min(days) FROM s) OR days=(SELECT max(days) FROM s) ORDER BY date

WITH c AS (SELECT date(insert_date) dt,city_name,row_number() over(partition by date(insert_date) order by city_id,city_name) rn FROM cities WHERE country_code_2='cn' AND insert_date >= '2021-07-01' AND insert_date < '2021-08-01'), d AS (SELECT dt,city_name,julianday(dt)-row_number() over(order by dt) island FROM c WHERE rn=1), s AS (SELECT island,count(*) days FROM d GROUP BY island) SELECT d.dt AS date,upper(substr(city_name,1,1))||lower(substr(city_name,2)) AS city_name FROM d JOIN s USING(island) WHERE days=(SELECT min(days) FROM s) OR days=(SELECT max(days) FROM s) ORDER BY date

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT insert_date AS dt FROM cities
  WHERE country_code_2='cn' AND insert_date >= '2021-07-01' AND insert_date <= '2021-07-31'
), g AS (
  SELECT dt, CAST(julianday(dt) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY dt) AS INT) AS grp FROM d
), runs AS (
  SELECT grp, COUNT(*) AS len FROM g GROUP BY grp
), sel AS (
  SELECT grp FROM runs WHERE len = (SELECT MIN(len) FROM runs)
  UNION
  SELECT grp FROM runs WHERE len = (SELECT MAX(len) FROM runs)
), rep AS (
  SELECT insert_date, MIN(city_name) AS city_name FROM cities
  WHERE country_code_2='cn' AND insert_date >= '2021-07-01' AND insert_date <= '2021-07-31'
  GROUP BY insert_date
)
SELECT g.dt AS insert_date,
       UPPER(SUBSTR(rep.city_name,1,1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(rep.city_name,2)) AS city_name
FROM g
JOIN sel ON sel.grp = g.grp
JOIN rep ON rep.insert_date = g.dt
ORDER BY g.dt

SELECT insert_date,group_concat(city_id||':'||city_name) choices,MIN(city_name) lexical FROM cities WHERE country_code_2='cn' AND insert_date IN ('2021-07-12','2021-07-19','2021-07-27') GROUP BY insert_date
